params.name: insurance_id
params.description: A unique identifier for a single provider network from the Insurances reference endpoint.

params.name: ssa_codes
params.description:
SSA codes of the counties to run a network analysis on. 

A maximum of 50 codes may be included in a single request.

params.name: exclude_npis
params.description:
When set to `true` the response will not list specific NPIs in the network but will continue to include the `npi_count` fields to let you know how many there are.

This parameter can be used to greater lower the amount of data sent back when specific NPIs are not necessary.

items.docs:
View a provider network across different geographies (i.e. counties).

#### Example Use Case
In looking to expand to a new region, analyze existing provider networks in the region to understand how best to construct your own.
